content:
## Source
.design/m5/44-mobile-app.md — REQ-1, REQ-8, AC-1, AC-8 + decomposition PR 2.

## Surface
- New module: `polaris-backend/src/notifications/`
  - `push.rs` — APNs (`a2`) + FCM (HTTP v1) + ntfy.sh dispatchers, selected by `[notifications.provider]` config
  - `registration.rs` — `POST /api/devices/register` endpoint
- New migration: `mobile_devices` (id UUID PK, moderator_id, platform ENUM, push_token TEXT, last_active_at TIMESTAMPTZ, revoked_at TIMESTAMPTZ?)
- New worker: subscribes to the v1 internal bus (Kafka/NATS) for `P1Escalation` events; fans out to device tokens via push provider.

## Push payload (REQ-8 / AC-8)
```json
{ "type": "p1", "incident_id": "<uuid>" }
```
No PII. No moderator name. No subject content. Unit-tested.

## Rust-quality notes
- **Push providers are pluggable.** `trait PushProvider { async fn dispatch(&self, token: &DeviceToken, payload: &Payload) -> Result<(), PushError>; }`. Impls: `ApnsProvider`, `FcmProvider`, `NtfyProvider`. Selected at startup from config; held in `ApiState::push_provider: Arc<dyn PushProvider>`.
- **`PushError` is `thiserror`** with variants `TokenStale`, `RateLimited`, `Unauthorized`, `Transport(#[from] reqwest::Error)`. Stale tokens trigger `mobile_devices.revoked_at = now()` automatically.
- **Per-device task isolation** via `tokio::task::JoinSet` so one slow APNs server doesn't poison the fan-out queue. Per rust-quality §10.
- **No `MutexGuard` across `.await`** in the device-token store. Pattern: snapshot the token list inside a sync lock, then iterate outside the lock.
- The registration endpoint uses the v1 auth middleware (session cookie required). Per rust-quality §3: returns `Result<…, ApiError>` with proper error mapping at the axum layer.
- Per rust-quality §7: integration test against APNs sandbox + FCM emulator, not against live production endpoints.

## External references
- `a2` crate (APNs): https://docs.rs/a2/latest/a2/
- FCM HTTP v1 API: https://firebase.google.com/docs/cloud-messaging/migrate-v1
- ntfy.sh API: https://docs.ntfy.sh/publish/
- APNs token-based auth (no certs): https://developer.apple.com/documentation/usernotifications/establishing_a_token-based_connection_to_apns

## Acceptance (AC-1, AC-8)
- [ ] AC-1: Fixture P1 event fires; push received on test device within 30s. Measured against APNs sandbox + FCM emulator.
- [ ] AC-8: Payload serialization test asserts no PII fields. Run on every PR.

## Blocks / blocked-by
- Blocked by #115 (platform choice).
- Blocks #117 (app shell registers via this endpoint).
